text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — Zephyrus wants a POC next Wed. They care about sustained throughput, microbursts, and an SLA note for latency. Also will need a cost sketch and answers for the security questionnaire. Can we sketch a run plan?
Tess: Got it. What's the target qps and model size?
Maria: Targeting 600–800 qps sustained, with short 5–10s microbursts to 2k qps. Model is a 7B chat model (~800 token avg response). Region: us-west primary, multi-az preferred.
Sam: OK. Proposed run plan: 30m ramp to 700 qps, 1h steady, 3 bursts at 2k for 10s separated by 10m, then cooldown. Capture p50/p95/p99 and CPU/GPU utilization + KV cache hit rate.
Li: We should test two variants: quantized (4-bit) and fp16. Quant gives ~1.8x throughput; fp16 better tail latency. I'll prepare model bundles.
Nikhil: For pricing sketch we need avg token size and prompt length. Maria, can you confirm avg prompt+response tokens?
Maria: Avg prompt 40 tokens, avg response 800 tokens -> ~840 tokens per call.
Tess: Security Qs: they asked about KMS key wraps, audit logs, and on-prem option. Can someone pull the standard sec answers?
Sam: I have a short runbook snippet we can use for ops:

```
# loadgen config
--target-qps 700
--max-concurrency 500
--burst-pattern "2k:10s x3"
--payload-samples ./zephyrus-samples.json
--metrics-endpoint http://prometheus:9090
```

Sam: Also note: enable prefix KV cache for steady latencies, but disable cross-tenant cache for security tests.
Li: Running quick micro benchmark on a single dedicated pool now. Will paste numbers.
DeployBot: build/deploy-zephyrus-model v2 started by Li — status: running
Li: Quick numbers from dedicated pool (single GPU type T4-equivalent, warm): sustained 720 qps, p95=170ms, p99=290ms, burst peak handled to 2k qps with queueing spike. Quantized run looks ~1.9x throughput but p99 increases ~1.2x.
Sam: Those look promising. For hosted SLA we usually see ~20–30% higher tail latencies vs dedicated. Factor that into the quote.
Nikhil: Ballpark cost calc for dedicated reserved: approx $X/kgpu-hr -> rough $2.1k/day to sustain 700 qps (incl amortized infra). For hosted per-token: estimate $0.45 per 1k tokens * 840 tokens -> ~$0.38 per request. Multiply by QPS/time to present both options.
Maria: Can you formalize both numbers into a short slide? The buyer will ask for multi-AZ failover cost delta.
Tess: I'll draft the sec answers: KMS: customer-managed keys supported via CloudKMS, audit logs: 365d retention on request (enterprise), on-prem: available as air-gapped appliance (timeline 6–8w).
Li: Follow-up run note: enable soft-eviction on KV cache reduced p99 by ~30% during bursts. Add that to recommendation.
Sam: Ops note: if they need consistent p99 <200ms at 700 qps, recommend Dedicated + reserved pool + smaller model or lower response tokens.
Maria: Perfect. Can we meet Thurs to finalize slide + security pack? I want to send POC charter to Zephyrus by EOD Fri.
Nikhil: Thurs 10am works for me.
Tess: 10am OK. I'll assemble sec questionnaire answers and the sample run report.
Maria: Thanks team. I'll book the run window for next Wed 02:00 UTC and send invites. :thumbsup:
